page.overview:
Who is Jenare Balmaen?

Jenare Balmaen is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Jenare Balmaen}}

She is pale and sturdy. She has a pale, square face.

Jenare is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was a part of the group of fifty-one sisters, led by Toveine Gazal, sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to take out the Black Tower. Jenare was part of the group of ten sisters led by Toviene herself when they were both shielded and captured and bonded by the Asha'man. Jenare was bonded by Welyn Kajima, a fact for which she blamed Toveine.
